info.title: Weekly Wellness Snapshot
info.description: Generates a non-medical weekly wellness summary from available app context, tasks, and recent topics.

/weekly.description: Creates a non-medical weekly wellness snapshot from available completed tasks, open tasks, recent topics, or recent app context. If no task data is available, the tool should return a safe general summary instead of asking the user to provide the missing data.

post.description: Generates a calm, practical, non-medical weekly wellness snapshot. This action does not provide diagnosis, therapy, psychiatric advice, medication advice, or emergency care. Missing task fields are allowed.

requestBody.description: Optional weekly task and topic information. If not provided, the Lambda should use available recent context or return a safe fallback.

completed_tasks.description: Optional list of completed task titles.

open_tasks.description: Optional list of open task titles.

recent_topics.description: Optional list of recent wellness topics such as sleep, stress, memory, overload, grounding, or daily routine.

recent_context_summary.description: Optional summary of recent app conversation or app-level memory.

language.description: Optional response language. Use he for Hebrew and en for English.

week_summary.description: Short summary of the user's weekly wellness state.

encouragement.description: Calm encouragement text for the user.

next_focus.description: Suggested practical focus for the next period.

disclaimer.description: Safety disclaimer that this is not medical care or diagnosis.
